title: Known-object test, TOI-5812.02
summary: Known-object test on TOI-5812.02: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 61 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 1 light curve(s), forming 11 distinct event(s), 6 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460549.4561 (ΔT 13.36 d); 1 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
